---
title: "Research Map"
description: "A living map of research themes, methods, technologies, and domains."
---

This interactive map represents research that has caught my attention across my reading. Papers are grouped and connected based on semantic similarity in their titles and abstracts, providing a living view of the themes and connections shaping my research interests rather than a systematic review of any field.

<div id="research-map-summary" class="research-map-summary" aria-live="polite"></div>

<div class="research-map-controls" aria-label="Research map controls">
  <label for="research-map-search">Search</label>
  <input id="research-map-search" type="search" placeholder="Paper title or topic">
  <label for="research-map-topic-filter">Topic</label>
  <select id="research-map-topic-filter">
    <option value="">All topics</option>
  </select>
  <button id="research-map-reset" type="button">Reset view</button>
</div>

<div class="research-map-layout">
  <div id="research-map-canvas" class="research-map-canvas" aria-label="Interactive research map"></div>
  <aside id="research-map-details" class="research-map-details" aria-live="polite">
    Select a paper or topic to inspect it.
  </aside>
</div>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="research-map/graph.css">
<script type="module" src="research-map/graph.js"></script>
